name: Collabora Online
summary: HTTP 9980 with the editing WebSocket kept open.
notes: Collabora has to be started with ssl.enable=false and ssl.termination=true to answer plain HTTP and still hand out https:// addresses; without them the target is https://. / answers a bare OK, which makes the check. A document is edited over one WebSocket for as long as it is open. With more than one server every request for a document has to reach the same one, which Collabora's documentation does by hashing the WOPISrc parameter (balance url_param WOPISrc check_post) -- a custom line on the backend pool, not something stickiness by address gets right.
